test-results.w: Every attempt an employee made: marks scored of total, the whole-percent score and pass / fail against the test's pass mark. Written by the test-taking flow; scored on the server from the question bank.
f: Score per attempt with marks and percent
Scored server-side, never by the browser
s: Employees take tests from Performance → Tests.
Open a row to correct a record; the answers are kept on it.
test-results.tip: Test Reports adds the pass rate per test and per department.

policies.w: Recovery / collection policies, the code of conduct, SOPs, data-privacy and grievance policies — each with its version, owner, effective date, board approval and review-due date, and whether agents must acknowledge it.
f: Version, owner, effective and review dates
A revision is a new row; the old one is marked superseded
s: Add the policy with its version and dates.
When it is revised, add the new version and mark the old one superseded.
policies.tip: The Code of Conduct text employees acknowledge lives in config/code-of-conduct.json; list the document here for the audit trail.
